beginner.title: Product Search Reflection
beginner.description: A sportswear store search page reflects the user's query without proper output encoding.
beginner.required_feature: Search form that displays the searched keyword

beginner.title: Comment Preview XSS
beginner.description: A blog comment preview renders user input before posting, allowing reflected script execution.

intermediate.title: User Profile Bio XSS

intermediate.required_feature: Edit profile page and public profile page

intermediate.title: Support Ticket Stored XSS
intermediate.description: A support ticket system stores customer messages and displays them in an admin view without proper escaping.
intermediate.required_feature: Ticket creation page and admin ticket viewer

advanced.title: Admin Audit Log XSS
advanced.description: An admin audit log records attacker-controlled values and later renders them inside a privileged dashboard.

advanced.title: Government Complaint Portal XSS

advanced.required_feature: Complaint submission page and staff review page
